name: J-Yuan Trust Co., Ltd.
summary: J-Yuan Trust Co., Ltd. operates as a trust company in China. It also engages in loans, leasing, investment, and Deposit activities, as well as the provision of cash management, fixed-income, securities investment, equity investment, and family trust services. The company was formerly known as Anxin Trust Co., Ltd and changed its name to J-Yuan Trust Co., Ltd. in May 2023. J-Yuan Trust Co., Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China. J-Yuan Trust Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shanghai Di'an Investment Management Co., Ltd.
